column3: Arrival ★ City of Kyoto
*yawn*
With a loud yawn, I stepped into the city of Kyoto.
The old capital, Kyoto...
The sun of this once-prosperous city stung my sleep-deprived eyes.
...Sleepy...
I'm so sleepy, o' land of Kyoto.
Even while inside the moving bullet train, despite Manami's pestering to play cards, I simply lazed around.
Kyou-chan... Are you all right?
Yeah.
Your face looks horrible.
Oh really...
Those are some serious eye-bags you got there...
Just lack of sleep... Well, it shouldn't be a problem since I slept on the bullet train, so don't worry about it.
I'm worried... Right, how about I lend you my shoulder?
Can you do such an embarrassing thing?
Eh?
Looks like she didn't get it... What a slowpoke.
The other way around is fine, but it's completely uncool for a guy to use a girl's shoulder!
Anyway, it's fine... *yawn*...
I'm sure you packed in a hurry last night? That's how you got sleep-deprived.
Something like that.
As always, she saw right through me.
That's right. I'm already so tired on the first day of the trip.
It's all because of my sister that my preparations for the trip took more time.
It was already close to dawn when I fell asleep.
Although I'm in Kyoto... it seems that I can't escape from my sister's curse.
I squinted my eyes towards the old city under the basking sun.
*yawn*
-and let out another grand yawn.
